name: documents
description: Create, edit, redline, comment on, render, verify, and export editable Microsoft Word DOCX document files in Anybox.

shortDescription.zh-CN: 制作可编辑的 Office Word DOCX 文档

longDescription.en-US: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, redline, comment on, and export editable Microsoft Word DOCX document files locally. Use Word Documents when the durable output or target is an Office Word document, DOCX file, memo, report, or writing artifact.
longDescription.zh-CN: 在本地制作、编辑、检查、渲染、验证、修订、评论并导出可在 Microsoft Office Word 中继续编辑的 DOCX/Word 文档。当目标产物是 Office Word 文档、DOCX 文件、备忘录、报告或写作材料时使用。

defaultPrompt: Draft a project memo as a document
Create a document from this outline
Write a polished doc for this plan

skillPreviews.name: Word DOCX Builder
skillPreviews.description: Create, edit, redline, and comment on editable Microsoft Word `.docx` files inside the local Anybox workspace, with a strict render-and-verify workflow. Use when the user wants an Office Word document, DOCX file, memo, report, or writing artifact.
